mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `consult_session`
user_id, expert_id, session_no, session_title, status, last_message_content, last_message_time, user_unread_count, expert_unread_count,
#{userId}, #{expertId}, #{sessionNo}, #{sessionTitle}, #{status}, #{lastMessageContent}, #{lastMessageTime}, #{userUnreadCount}, #{expertUnreadCount},
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `consult_session` s
WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.expert_id = #{expertId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM `consult_session` s
WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.expert_id = #{expertId} AND s.status != 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS user_id, e.id AS expert_id, NULL AS session_no, NULL AS session_title, NULL AS status, NULL AS last_message_content, NULL AS last_message_time, NULL AS user_unread_count, NULL AS expert_unread_count, NULL AS create_time, NULL AS update_time, NULL AS username, NULL AS nickname, e.real_name AS expert_name, e.avatar AS expert_avatar, e.user_id AS expert_user_id FROM `expert_profile` e WHERE e.service_status = 1 AND e.consultation_status = 1 AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.rating DESC, e.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM `consult_session` s
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(1) AS user_unread_count FROM `consult_message` WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY session_id ) unread ON unread.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status != 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `consult_session` newer WHERE newer.user_id = s.user_id AND newer.expert_id = s.expert_id AND newer.status != 0 AND ( COALESCE(newer.last_message_time, newer.update_time, newer.create_time) > COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) OR ( COALESCE(newer.last_message_time, newer.update_time, newer.create_time) = COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) AND newer.id > s.id ) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT FROM `consult_session` s
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(1) AS expert_unread_count FROM `consult_message` WHERE receiver_id = #{expertUserId} AND is_read = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY session_id ) unread ON unread.session_id = s.id WHERE e.user_id = #{expertUserId} AND s.status != 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.update_time, s.create_time) DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `consult_session` s INNER JOIN `expert_profile` e ON e.id = s.expert_id SET s.expert_unread_count = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND e.user_id = #{expertUserId}

UPDATE `consult_session` SET last_message_content = #{lastMessageContent}, last_message_time = NOW(), expert_unread_count = COALESCE(expert_unread_count, 0) + CASE WHEN #{receiverIsExpert} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, user_unread_count = COALESCE(user_unread_count, 0) + CASE WHEN #{receiverIsExpert} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{id}
